Reliable sources with a track record of accurate leaks have revealed that next year may see the launch of the largest-screened iPhone in history.

Supply chain sources indicate that Apple is testing a new display, which could potentially be used in a new iPhone model whose designation is still unknown...

The Naming Mystery of Next Year's Flagship iPhone

2027 marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone launch, and there has been widespread belief that Apple is secretly developing a major new product. The company is expected to come very close to its long-standing design vision that year — that of the iPhone becoming "a single sheet of glass".

Some speculate that Apple may release a special 20th anniversary edition iPhone, similar to what was done with the iPhone X. However, more recent reports suggest that this groundbreaking new design will debut directly as next year's Pro models (namely the iPhone 19 Pro and Pro Max).

A third possibility is that Apple, to mark the anniversary, will skip directly from the iPhone 18 to the iPhone 20.

The Largest iPhone Display Ever

Leaker Digital Chat Station (DCS) said that supply chain sources indicate Apple is currently testing the largest iPhone display ever. However, the size increase is relatively modest compared to the existing iPhone 17 Pro Max, which features a 6.9-inch screen.

In other words, they believe Apple will use a "7-inch display" as a marketing highlight.

DCS did not provide any information on the purpose of the new display (assuming Apple actually follows through with it), but speculated it may be used in next year's iPhone Pro Max — regardless of the final model name.

9to5Mac's View

Apple tests many different things, but most of them never make it to market, so even if this display truly exists as a prototype within the company's supply chain, that does not necessarily mean it will end up in an iPhone.

However, if the company's goal is to create the look of "a single sheet of glass," being able to boast the largest display ever seems like a reasonable marketing strategy.
